title: Design System: Blueprint for CPFB app builders

display.purpose: The step heading, wide (112%). One per page.

title.purpose: Panel and Dialog titles, drawn from a plain string.

lead.purpose: Product name, sub-sections, legends, note titles, the line under a heading.

body.purpose: Running text, fields, nav links, md buttons.

small.purpose: Hints, stamps, tags, segmented choices, step counter. Narrow (80%) for hotel labels.

label.purpose: Declared step; no shipped use on the builder screens. Not for kickers.

motion.name: hotel-drop
motion.value: built pieces drop in when a tool is ticked; off under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The memorable moment: ticking a tool builds part of the hotel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ink main action, at the foot of the side panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--color-ink, #1c2b3a); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(28,43,58,.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c2b3a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: #fff; color: #1c2b3a; border: 1px solid #9aa8b8; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #1c2b3a; background: #f6f8fa; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c2b3a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Paper field with a strong rule, label above, hint below the label.
components.html: A short name.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; color: #1c2b3a; } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #4b5c70; } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; background: #fff; color: #1c2b3a; border: 1px solid #9aa8b8; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:hover, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #1c2b3a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c2b3a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4b5c70; opacity: .8; }

components.name: Header
components.description: The simple 56px header: product name, sheets, step counter, role.
components.html:
Blueprint
New planSaved projects
Step 4 of 5
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 56px; padding: 0 32px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #d5dce4; color: #1c2b3a; } .ds-brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 112%; } .ds-header nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav { font-size: 16px; color: #4b5c70; text-underline-offset: 6px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { color: #1c2b3a; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav-current { color: #1c2b3a; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-step { flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; color: #4b5c70; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Note
components.description: A one-rule box. Attention and error use redline wash.
components.html:
One question is open

Ask your reviewer before you save.
components.css: .ds-note { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #fbeceb; border: 1px solid rgba(184,50,42,.5); border-radius: 3px; color: #1c2b3a; font-size: 16px; } .ds-note-title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Marks an exception: not yet verified. A second rule sits outside the first.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 6px; background: #fff; color: #b8322a; border: 1px solid #b8322a; outline: 1px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 1px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A ruled strip of choices. The chosen one is washed and underlined in ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #9aa8b8; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-seg-b { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-right: 1px solid #9aa8b8; background: transparent; color: #4b5c70; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-b:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-seg-b:hover { background: #f6f8fa; color: #1c2b3a; } .ds-seg-on { background: #f6f8fa; color: #1c2b3a; border-bottom-color: #1c2b3a; }

components.name: Hotel Label
components.description: Two-line paper label on a leader line: part name and requirement count. A redline dot marks an open question.
components.css: .ds-hlabel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; width: 192px; height: 46px; padding: 0 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d5dce4; border-radius: 3px; font-stretch: 80%; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.2; color: #1c2b3a; } .ds-hl1 { font-weight: 600; } .ds-hl2 { color: #4b5c70; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The app is a hotel that is first a drawing and then gets built. The officer sees what the app needs as parts of a building, drawn as an isometric cutaway in thin blue line on a pale fill. Each tool they tick builds some of those parts in warm Kenney materials. The light comes on only when every claim is Verified.

The page around the hotel is quiet on purpose: drafting-white ground, navy ink, 1px rules, 3px corners, no shadows. The hotel is the only colour on the page. There is no grid paper, no title block, no legend. State is never colour alone: each hotel label carries words and a count.

One token set serves every screen, including the admin and verifier screens, which took the tokens but keep their older layout until their own redesign. The app is desktop only (1280 by 800 and up).
keyCharacteristics: Drafting-white ground, navy ink, 1px rules, 3px corners, no shadows.
One typeface, Archivo, in three widths: wide for page headings, normal for reading, narrow for hotel labels and counts.
The hotel carries all the colour. The page carries none.
One ink main action per step. Other actions are outline buttons or text links.
Lists are ruled schedules, not stacks of cards.

rules.name: The Hotel Is The Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour on the page comes from the hotel. Chrome stays ink, paper and ground.

rules.name: The Redline Rule
rules.body: Redline means a question or a need for attention. Never decoration, emphasis or brand.

rules.name: The Line Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: Hotel Line fails as text on paper. It draws, it never writes.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: Use only the text-* steps declared in globals.css. Do not write pixel font sizes.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Wide (112%) is for headings, narrow (80%) is for hotel labels and counts, normal is for everything read.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Shadowed Rule
rules.body: A layer is separated by a 1px rule or a border colour change, never by a shadow.

dos: Do build screens from the kit in app/ui and the tokens in app/globals.css.
Do keep one ink main action visible per step. Use secondary and quiet for the rest.
Do show state in words and counts as well as colour.
Do use wide for headings and narrow for hotel labels. Use tabular figures (tnum) for counts and dates.
Do use 1px rules between list rows in one ruled box.
Do pick widths by role: max-w-page, max-w-form, max-w-message, max-w-measure.
Do keep stamps for exceptions: not yet verified, published, sample.
donts: Don't use redline for anything that is not a question or a need for attention.
Don't add shadows, grid paper, title-block cells or a legend.
Don't round corners past 3px or make pills.
Don't stack separate cards for a list, or show two solid main actions at once.
Don't use uppercase labels, kickers or eyebrows.
